name: smwblocks-double-powerup-block-pack
title: Double Powerup Block Pack
description:
When the player hits any of these blocks from the Bottom, it will store two of the same powerups to the player, to his status ($7E:0019) and to the "Item Box" content. Furthermore, it will blow up, make a small quake and play a sound effect.

Contains:
-A Mushroom Version
-A Fire Flower Version
-A Feather/Cape Version
-A Mushroom Shop version
-A Fire Flower Shop version
-A Feather/Cape Shop version.

The shop version can be configured in the ASM file. More information can be found in the readme.
